detailedPairs.key: [L179-Q1-0] Retraction
detailedPairs.cleanKey: Retraction

detailedPairs.key: [L179-Q1-1] Clarification
detailedPairs.cleanKey: Clarification

detailedPairs.rationale: Connects "Clarification" directly to the defining quality "explanation, meant, earlier".

detailedPairs.key: [L179-Q1-2] Walk Back
detailedPairs.cleanKey: Walk Back

detailedPairs.rationale: Connects "Walk Back" directly to the defining quality "quietly, retreat, earlier".

detailedPairs.key: [L179-Q1-3] Doubling Down
detailedPairs.cleanKey: Doubling Down
detailedPairs.value: To become more firmly committed to a position, especially after facing criticism.
detailedPairs.rationale: Connects "Doubling Down" directly to the defining quality "become, firmly, committed".

detailedPairs.key: [L179-Q1-4] Damage Control
detailedPairs.cleanKey: Damage Control

detailedPairs.rationale: Connects "Damage Control" directly to the defining quality "Actions, taken, limit".

quests.explanation: Retraction and clarification are both ways of formally addressing a mistaken statement, one taking it back, one explaining it. Doubling down is different from the rest — it's a refusal to back away from the mistake, not a way of addressing it.
quests.hint: Four of these describe ways a company might respond after a mistake. One describes becoming firmer instead of backing down.
